headline: Government Working to Ensure Supply Is Not Hindered to Keep Commodity Prices Stable - MZamin
summary: Commerce Minister Khandaker Abdul Muktadir said the government is working to keep supplies flowing so commodity prices stay stable. He noted that fuel oil prices have been partially adjusted.
why: Fuel price adjustments feed into transport and food costs, which affect inflation and household purchasing power in Bangladesh.
